item.title: AHEPA Senior Living Opens Second South Bend Community
item.description: AHEPA Senior Living, a leading nationwide nonprofit provider of affordable housing and supportive services for older adults has opened AHEPA 100 Phase II Apartments, a 72-unit affordable senior housing community in South Bend, announced President and CEO Steve Beck.

item.title: Leising: Bill Addressing Veterinary Shortage Passes Out Of Committee
item.description: A bill authored by Sen. Jean Leising, R-Oldenburg, to expand the pool of veterinarians and veterinary technicians in Indiana passed out of the Senate Committee on Agriculture today.

item.title: ‘Coolest Thing’ Field Trimmed To 8, Including Companies In Elkhart
